name: SUNO AM Tincture – 200MG
description: Made with 100% refined hemp seed oil and a balanced blend of 200mg each of THC, CBD, and CBG. Each 30mL bottle provides approximately 6.66mg of each cannabinoid per 1mL serving. Metered droppers ensure accurate dosing every time. Vegan. Nut-free. Free of dyes, sugar, and gluten. Clinically Relevant Cannabis. Clinically Relevant Results.
